convert_script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

# Read the docx content
doc = Document("docs/customer_report.docx")
paragraphs = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    paragraphs.append((para.text, para.style.name))

# Create PDF using PyMuPDF
pdf = fitz.open()

page = pdf.new_page(width=595, height=842)  # A4 size
y = 72  # top margin

for text, style in paragraphs:
    if not text.strip():
        y += 12
        continue
    if "Heading" in style:
        fontsize = 18
        fontname = "helv"
    else:
        fontsize = 11
        fontname = "helv"

    text_point = fitz.Point(72, y)
    page.insert_text(text_point, text, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
    y += fontsize + 6

pdf.save("docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully at docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
await write_file("./convert_to_pdf.py", convert_script)
print("Conversion script written")

convert_result = await run_command("python ./convert_to_pdf.py")
print(convert_result)

pdf_check = await get_file_info("./docs/customer_report.pdf")

email_script = '''
import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = "agent@workspace.local"
msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Report"

body = "Hi Bob,\\n\\nPlease find the customer report attached as a PDF.\\n\\nBest regards"
msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

with open("docs/customer_report.pdf", "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

# Try sending via localhost SMTP
try:
    server = smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25, timeout=5)
    server.sendmail(msg["From"], [msg["To"]], msg.as_string())
    server.quit()
    print("Email sent successfully via localhost SMTP")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"SMTP send attempt: {e}")
    # Save the email as .eml file as fallback
    with open("docs/customer_report_email.eml", "w") as ef:
        ef.write(msg.as_string())
    print("Email saved as docs/customer_report_email.eml (no SMTP server available)")
'''
await write_file("./send_email.py", email_script)
print("Email script written")

email_result = await run_command("python ./send_email.py")
print(email_result)

x = 72  # left margin

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        y += 14
        continue

    style_name = para.style.name if para.style else ""

    if "Heading 1" in style_name or "Title" in style_name:

        fontname = "helv"

    page.insert_text(fitz.Point(x, y), text, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
    y += fontsize + 6

pdf.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully")

import os
import sys
import fire
import shutil
import subprocess

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".."))
from _log import log_tool_call


def _convert_to_pdf(word_file_path, pdf_file_path):
    try:
        output_dir = os.path.dirname(pdf_file_path)
        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
        lo_bin = shutil.which("libreoffice") or shutil.which("soffice")
        if lo_bin:
            subprocess.call([lo_bin, "--headless", "--convert-to", "pdf", word_file_path, "--outdir", output_dir])
            stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(word_file_path))[0]
            generated = os.path.join(output_dir, stem + ".pdf")
            if generated != pdf_file_path and os.path.exists(generated):
                os.rename(generated, pdf_file_path)
            if os.path.exists(pdf_file_path):
                return True
        from docx import Document
        from fpdf import FPDF
        doc = Document(word_file_path)
        pdf = FPDF()
        pdf.set_margins(15, 15, 15)
        pdf.add_page()
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", size=11)
        for para in doc.paragraphs:
            text = para.text.strip()
            if text:
                safe = text.encode("latin-1", errors="replace").decode("latin-1")
                pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, safe)
                pdf.ln(2)
        pdf.output(pdf_file_path)
        return os.path.exists(pdf_file_path)
    except Exception:
        return False


@log_tool_call("word.convert_to_pdf")
def main(word_file_path, pdf_file_path):
    if not os.path.exists(word_file_path):
        return f"OBSERVATION: The word file {word_file_path} does not exist. Failed to convert the file to pdf."
    success = _convert_to_pdf(word_file_path, pdf_file_path)
    if success:
        return f"OBSERVATION: Successfully convert {word_file_path} to {pdf_file_path}"
    return f"OBSERVATION: Failed to convert {word_file_path} to {pdf_file_path}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    fire.Fire(main)
